main_text.l: Veritatem impense adamare, & perpetuo studio prosequi.
Toto animo in modestiam & humilitatem incumbere.
Ponere animum & curam in methodo & ordine accurato.
Fouere & retinere modestiam ac prudentem iudicandi libertatem
Studere vtilitati & vero vsui, non otiosa futilitati.

page.notes: The running head is set in spaced capitals. Headings "Quarta." through "Duodecima." are ordinal labels in the printed ordinal series and are given level 2 for consistency. The catchword "Cap. XIV." is the chapter reference at the foot. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
